title: Enquirer’s Guide: What is the Prime Referent?
summary: It is the point from which the first stable probe departed in 1844.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “What is the Prime Referent?”
It is the point from which the first stable probe departed in 1844.
Eideticians chose it as the zero point for their surveys. This does not mean it is the center of the Stratum or the source of all Referents.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
